title: LLM Enhancement with Domain Expert Mental Model to Reduce LLM Hallucination with Causal Prompt Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2509.10818v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When consequential decisions depend on knowledge that exists nowhere in writing, LLMs hallucinate not from retrieval failure but from model absence. RAG and knowledge-graph methods share a structural ceiling. They cannot supply what has never been recorded. This paper reconceptualizes that failure as a model discovery problem. The proposed causal prompt engineering framework discovers and encodes a decision logic of a domain expert as an Expert Mental Model (EMM), providing it as principled input to LLM reasoning supplying what no retrieval method can. The framework is grounded in the theory of monotone Boolean and k-valued functions. translated_title: 基于领域专家心智模型与因果提示工程减少大语言模型幻觉的增强方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.10818v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：当关键决策依赖于书面记录中不存在知识时，大语言模型产生幻觉并非源于检索失败，而是源于模型缺失。RAG（检索增强生成）和知识图谱方法存在结构性局限，无法提供从未被记录的内容。本文将这一失败重新概念化为模型发现问题。所提出的因果提示工程框架将领域专家的决策逻辑发现并编码为专家心智模型（EMM），作为原则性输入提供给大语言模型推理，弥补了任何检索方法无法提供的部分。该框架基于单调布尔函数和k值函数理论。一个关键技术贡献是形式化了三个此前在新型领域未开发的大语言模型辅助前置过程：因子公式化、因子单调化，以及保持单调性的层次结构构建。这些过程支持一个四步EMM构建算法，减少了知识获取中的不确定性。
tldr: 本文提出一种因果提示工程框架，通过形式化专家决策逻辑为专家心智模型，解决大语言模型在无书面记录知识领域中的幻觉问题，超越传统检索方法的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a causal prompt engineering framework that encodes domain expert decision logic as an Expert Mental Model to reduce LLM hallucination in domains with unwritten knowledge, surpassing retrieval-based methods.
